svg.title: AI Automation for Reporting and Dashboards
svg.desc: Animated workflow showing how Enablly's forward-deployed AI automation handles reporting and dashboards: raw data arrives from spreadsheets, CRM, and ad platforms; a data agent cleans and matches columns; AI builds live charts with Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini; an LLM writes plain-English commentary with Claude and OpenAI; a manager checks the numbers; and a live dashboard plus team summary is ready in one click.

g.text: AI Automation for Reporting and Dashboards
